testcase.system-out: Scenario: Cancel an inline view rename with Escape ✔ Given an empty part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And an active copied view is named "Capture View" ✔ When the user selects the copied view and presses F2 ✔ And the user replaces its name with "Temporary View" ✔ And the user presses Escape ✔ Then inline editing closes ✔ And the active view remains named "Capture View" ✔ And the View branch identifies "Capture View" as active
